name: web-novel-translator
description: A tray-driven web novel translator built with Electron and React (popup window + global hotkey).
author: Web Novel Translator

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke:run
scripts.dist: node scripts/clean.mjs release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.dist:dir: node scripts/clean.mjs release && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --dir
scripts.dist:offline: node scripts/clean.mjs release-offline && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.offline.config.js
scripts.dist:offline:dir: node scripts/clean.mjs release-offline && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.offline.config.js --dir
scripts.dist:ci: node scripts/clean.mjs release && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win --publish never
